workspace.title: Lifecycle proposal, human review, and timeline
workspace.description: Create explicit governance commands and inspect normalized immutable evidence returned by the existing backend-owned lifecycle contracts.
workspace.boundaryTitle: No command on this page applies a lifecycle transition.
workspace.boundaryDescription: The browser submits generated OpenAPI request shapes only. Backend domain factories validate lifecycle states, permitted transitions, evidence requirements, review outcomes, and resulting-snapshot rules.
workspace.proposalDescription: Enter the requested transition. The browser does not infer a target, approve the request, or validate domain eligibility.
workspace.proposalCommandBoundary: One synchronous command. No persistence, promotion, paper run, or automatic follow-up.
workspace.proposalResponseDescription: The normalized proposal is available for inspection and an explicit human review command.
workspace.sourceSnapshotBoundary: This immutable source snapshot remains distinct from any proposal or review outcome.
workspace.reviewDescription: The review carries the latest successful normalized proposal response. Enter the outcome explicitly; the browser does not infer it from proposal or evidence fields.
workspace.includeResulting: Include an explicit caller-supplied resulting snapshot
workspace.resultingBoundary: The backend validates whether a resulting snapshot is allowed or required for the supplied outcome. Inclusion never makes the snapshot current or proves execution.
workspace.reviewCommandBoundary: This command records governance evidence only. It does not apply the requested transition.
workspace.reviewResponseDescription: The normalized record is available for inspection. No lifecycle execution is inferred.
workspace.resultingSnapshotBoundary: This returned snapshot is immutable evidence. The workspace does not identify it as globally current or executed.
workspace.timelineEmptyDescription: Create a proposal to inspect its immutable source snapshot, unresolved evidence references, and non-executing proposal event in order.

editor.optionalValues: Optional caller-supplied values; order and duplicates are preserved.
editor.snapshotDescription: This is an explicit caller-supplied snapshot. The browser does not declare it current or derive it from another record.
editor.timestampGuidance: Supply an explicit timestamp accepted by the backend.
editor.evidenceDescription: References remain unresolved pointers. The backend decides whether the supplied evidence types satisfy the requested transition.
editor.noEvidence: No evidence references supplied. The backend will validate this proposal.
editor.label: Label

inspection.proposalBoundary: This proposal is a request for human review. It is not approval, execution, promotion, or a current-state change.
inspection.reviewBoundary: The outcome below is a human-controlled record. It does not prove execution, automatically promote the strategy, or make any snapshot current.
inspection.timelineBoundary: This in-session sequence is assembled only from the command responses shown on this page. It is not a persisted current-state read model.
inspection.sourceEvent: Caller-supplied state: {state}. No current-state claim is inferred.
inspection.proposalEvent: Requested transition to {state}. Proposal creation is non-executing.
inspection.reviewEvent: Recorded outcome: {outcome}. This is governance evidence, not execution evidence.
inspection.resultingEvent: Returned state: {state}. The workspace does not mark this snapshot current.
